item.tib: dbal phur nag po'i cha lag bdud rtsi rgyan
item.coloph: bon gyi bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyi dus su bla chen dran pa nam mkhas spa gro phug gcal du gter du sbas/ phyis dar ba'i smon lam btab/ sa pho stag lo la khu tsha zla 'od 'bar gyis gter zhal phyes/ rong pa mgar nag 'bum chung la stag sgro gzig sgro bcas babs/ mnyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan yan rim par brgyud nas dge'o//
